dict.string: Lifr uses Face ID to unlock, when you turn on its lock in Settings.
Lifr listens when you tap the microphone in a chat: to record a clip for the assistant to hear, or to write what you say into your message. What you say stays on this device.
Lifr writes what you say into your message when you tap the microphone in a chat. Your speech is recognized on this device and isn't sent anywhere.
Lifr opens the camera when you tap Camera in a chat, to take a photo for the assistant to look at. The photo stays on this device.
Lifr shows your recent photos when you tap + in a chat, so you can attach one for the assistant to look at. Only the photos you attach are used, and they stay on this device.
